codex.reason: The reviews it starts run through review-prs, whose reviewers here start without the reviewer agent's guard, since a Codex hook lets a tool call through when it fails, and on the session's model; its gh calls need network access, which Codex's default sandbox turns off. See "Network access" in docs/codex-support.md for the ways to open the network.

copilot-cli.reason: The reviews it starts run through review-prs, which here runs the generic reviewer and delegation-free specialists inline, without the reviewer agent's guard, since a Copilot CLI hook lets a tool call through when it times out, and fails a specialists manifest that keeps agent-delegation.
